description: Comprehensive collection of GraphQL query templates for all operations

templates.name: System Health Check
templates.description: Basic health check query to verify system status
templates.queryText: query HealthCheck { health { status timestamp database version } }

templates.name: List All Tables
templates.description: Get all tables in the system with pagination
templates.queryText: query GetTables($limit: Int, $offset: Int) { tables(limit: $limit, offset: $offset) { nodes { id identifier name description createdAt nodeCount } totalCount hasNextPage } }

templates.name: Create New Table
templates.description: Create a new table with identifier, name and description
templates.queryText: mutation CreateTable($input: CreateTableInput!) { createTable(input: $input) { id identifier name description createdAt } }

templates.name: Create Attribute Type
templates.description: Create a new attribute type for a table
templates.queryText: mutation CreateAttributeType($input: CreateAttributeTypeInput!) { createAttributeType(input: $input) { id identifier name description dataType isRequired } }

templates.name: Create Node
templates.description: Create a new node in a specified table
templates.queryText: mutation CreateNode($input: CreateNodeInput!) { createNode(input: $input) { id content title createdAt table { id identifier } } }

templates.name: Search Nodes
templates.description: Search nodes within a table with content filtering
templates.queryText: query SearchNodes($input: SearchNodesInput!) { searchNodes(input: $input) { nodes { id content title createdAt attributes { id value attribute { identifier name } } } totalCount } }

templates.name: Set Node Attribute
templates.description: Set or update an attribute value for a node
templates.queryText: mutation SetNodeAttribute($input: SetNodeAttributeInput!) { setNodeAttribute(input: $input) { id value attribute { identifier name } } }

templates.name: Create Relation Type
templates.description: Create a relationship type between two tables
templates.queryText: mutation CreateRelationType($input: CreateRelationTypeInput!) { createRelationType(input: $input) { id identifier name description sourceTable { identifier } targetTable { identifier } } }

templates.name: Create Node Relation
templates.description: Create a relationship between two nodes
templates.queryText: mutation CreateRelation($input: CreateRelationInput!) { createRelation(input: $input) { id sourceNode { id content } targetNode { id content } relationType { identifier name } } }

templates.name: Search Related Nodes
templates.description: Find nodes related to a source node through relationships
templates.queryText: query SearchRelatedNodes($input: SearchRelatedNodesInput!) { searchRelatedNodes(input: $input) { nodes { id content attributes { value attribute { identifier } } outgoingRelations { id targetNode { id content } relationType { identifier } } } totalCount } }

templates.name: Advanced Node Search
templates.description: Advanced search with multiple criteria and filters
templates.queryText: query AdvancedSearch($input: AdvancedSearchInput!) { advancedSearch(input: $input) { nodes { id content title attributes { value attribute { identifier name } } table { identifier name } } totalCount executionTime } }

templates.name: Node Analytics
templates.description: Get analytics and statistics for nodes in a table
templates.queryText: query AnalyzeNodes($input: AnalyzeNodesInput!) { analyzeNodes(input: $input) { totalNodes attributeDistribution { attribute value count } relationshipCounts { type count } creationTrends { date count } } }

templates.name: Bulk Create Nodes
templates.description: Template for creating multiple nodes with attributes in batch
templates.queryText: mutation BulkCreateNodes($tableId: String!, $nodes: [NodeInput!]!) { nodes: createMultipleNodes(tableId: $tableId, inputs: $nodes) { id content title createdAt } }
